data.name: Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket-
data.detailed_description:
A side-scrolling psychological horror where you only walk ←.

This time set inside a supermarket after closing hours!

■ABOUT THIS GAME

With over 150 million views across related videos, Tsugunohi has become a cult phenomenon online.
In Tsugunohi, the story unfolds simply by moving the protagonist to the left—a minimalist yet chilling style of Japanese horror.

This time, Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket-, set inside a supermarket after closing hours, arrives on Steam as a standalone title!

As always in the Tsugunohi series, all you need to do is move the protagonist to the left.
With no complex controls, you can fully immerse yourself in the realistic and uncanny horror crafted by ImCyan.

Once you clear the game, a hidden scenario linked to real-world time will unlock—ushering in even more terrifying moments.

For this standalone release, a special Art & Setting Archive has been added, allowing you to explore the creation background and deeper worldbuilding.

When you finally understand the meaning behind the eerie language, a new, deeper layer of fear will strike you…

■STORY

Yumi Kiritachi, a high-school girl working part-time at a supermarket, notices that shoplifting incidents have recently increased.

Time passes without catching the culprit—but it seems the one taking the products may not be human at all…

■PROFILE

Tsugunohi Series
ImCyan is an indie game creator known for producing numerous horror titles. His most iconic work is the Tsugunohi series.

The hallmark of the series is its simple mechanic: “just walk left.”
While walking along everyday locations—your usual route home, your workplace—the player experiences everyday life gradually swallowed by creeping dread.

Savor the slow descent as ordinary life becomes increasingly unsettling.

■Notice of DLC Page Unpublishing

The store page for the DLC version of Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket- will be unpublished on December 18, 2025, at 7:00 AM.

■For those who have already purchased the DLC version of Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket-

If you have already purchased Tsugunohi -Supernatural Supermarket- as DLC for Tsugunohi,
you do not need to purchase it again from this store page.

After release, this standalone version will be automatically added to your Steam library.
There is no need to buy anything again.

The DLC version will remain playable as long as you do not delete it.
If you delete it, please download the standalone version automatically added to your library.

Although the DLC store page will be hidden from general users,
you can continue to access it from your Steam client.

■Gameplay Streaming Guidelines

1. Allowed Platforms
You may stream or upload gameplay on the following platforms:
YouTube, Niconico, Twitch, X, Facebook, your own website, and other video-sharing platforms.

2. Conditions of Use

(1) Commercial Use
Commercial use is not permitted.
However, you may monetize your videos using features officially provided by video-sharing platforms
(e.g., YouTube Partner Program, Super Chat).

(2) Required Attribution
When streaming, please include the following information:

＝＝＝＝＝
＜Official Links＞

・Tsugunohi Official X

・Tsugunohi Steam Page

・Tsugunohi Fan Club

・Tsugunohi Official Website

＜Copyright Notice＞
・© vaka, Inc. All Rights Reserved
＝＝＝＝＝

If the “©” symbol cannot be displayed due to platform specifications or text limits,
or if the work is a collaboration title, please check the FAQ for alternate notation rules.

(3) Spoilers
If your content includes story spoilers, please mark your stream/video appropriately
(e.g., “Contains spoilers”) to ensure all players can enjoy the game.

(4) Prohibited Content
Streaming or posting the following is prohibited:

・Anything violating laws or public order
・Content infringing on intellectual property, reputation, privacy, or other rights
・Videos consisting only of extracted in-game movies or music with no original creative input
・Streaming the game before its official release date
・Illegally obtaining, modifying, or altering the game program or data
・Content that harms the image or reputation of the game, the developer, or related parties
・Content that may mislead viewers into believing you are officially endorsed or affiliated
・Any other content deemed inappropriate by the developer

(5) Removal Requests
If we determine a stream violates these guidelines or is otherwise inappropriate,
we may request its deletion or suspension.
Upon request, please remove or suspend the content without delay.

(6) Inquiries
We do not respond to individual inquiries regarding these guidelines or streaming permissions.

(7) Updates
These guidelines may be updated at any time.
Please check the latest version before posting gameplay content.

data.short_description: You only walk to the left. A classic entry in the J-horror Tsugunohi series now comes to Steam. A part-time high-school girl hears unsettling rumors inside the supermarket after closing time…
data.supported_languages: Japanese, English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Open GL compliant video card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains imagery of skeletal remains, blood elements, and deceased individuals that some players may find disturbing.
Please note that the experience does not include pursuit sequences or psychologically intense situations designed to cause distress.
The content is free from profanity, sexually explicit material, and depictions of substance use or illegal activities.
